stage.note: produces logits rather than transforming them; scored with the same metric code as every other route

_limits: seed checkpoint: says nothing about what 600 backbone LoRA steps buy
one fit is one draw; no seed dispersion, so a gap below the run-to-run spread is not evidence
the feature cache is amortised: the first cycle pays the backbone pass, later ones do not

_note: proxy and medium are both carved from dev, so both are scored on dev features; what differs per split is the refit, not the feature file. The head is fitted on train only, which is disjoint from both.
